rawContent: Went to a great workshop on rights of survivors when talking to the media delivered by @IpsoNews and @Angles_project last night. If you’re a survivor who’s thinking of talking to the media, check out https://t.co/CBOjzfq9gG for advice or give them a ring #MeToo #DomesticAbuse #dv https://t.co/uZeA8uwt2a
Well this is one of the worst responses to being outed as abusive I’ve read since #MeToo. Nice one Ryan #RyanAdams

I'm running the #HackneyHalf this May in aid of @campaigncamp! Bootcamp was so important for me on my journey as a survivor activist - that's why I'm hoping to raise enough for a survivor scholarship. Click to donate:  https://t.co/mbI4Xy9RQI @gofundme #MeToo #survivor #dv https://t.co/Dd2GSP87rQ

From the Black Panthers to BLM - Black political groups have done some of the best organising to address the oppression mothers and carers face. We should all learn from them #BlackLivesMatter #BLM https://t.co/1Dh5y0aa2G

Content warning - death/suicide. This is really awful - NGO ignored warnings about bullying boss, both before and after climate activist Holly's suicide #CharityTuesday #MeToo #CharitySector #ClimateActivism https://t.co/PQY0hb9ODG via @ClimateHome

Been thinking a lot about the importance of building POC networks in the campaigning/activism space. So it was so good to meet with @fulloffaith22, @KelseyMxMo and others yesterday and talk about coalition building, #BLM and #MeToo. Thank you @we_level_up for facilitating! https://t.co/sjX9FiN7Gv
